name: Transition wipe — demo
description: Multi-state transition fixture (ADR-0026 / ADR-0022 model): a left-to-right mask-wipe from the text-3d-cylinder bumper to the title-card-newspaper card. The engine snapshots each state at its settled frame into a texture, then wipes between the two static textures — proving per-pixel A/B selection (a true wipe, not a crossfade). High-contrast pair (dark+yellow → light paper) so the moving boundary is unmistakable.
